project_context.name: PROJECT VAANI / GENESIS
project_context.description: A premium AI operating system for rural governance in India. Bridging citizens and government services via voice and multilingual chat. Includes a 3D cinematic landing page and a polished, highly usable functional app.
project_context.vibe: Timeless, premium, minimal, warm, elegant, calm. Everything should breathe. Nothing should scream.

design_system.archetype: Organic & Earthy blended with Luxury (Apple/Notion aesthetic but deeply rooted in Indian warmth)

orb_states.speaking: from-amber-400 to-orange-300 (Audio-reactive waves, warm and human)
orb_states.success: from-emerald-400 to-green-300 (Gentle outward burst, calm resolution)

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs. Elements must breathe.
spacing_and_layout.grids: Use Bento grid variations with asymmetry for landing page. For app dashboard, use strict dense grids (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4) but with generous internal padding.

glassmorphism.light: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-2xl backdrop-saturate-150 border border-white/40 shadow-sm
glassmorphism.dark: bg-[#0B0E0C]/70 backdrop-blur-2xl backdrop-saturate-150 border border-white/10 shadow-xl

surfaces.cards: Subtle borders (1px) with extremely soft ambient shadows. Nested radii: child components should have slightly smaller border-radius than their containers. DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for cards or overlays.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-transform, transition-colors duration-300 ease-out. Never use transition-all.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle lift (-translate-y-1) and slight shadow increase. Explicit text color changes on hover.
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-up (Framer Motion) for lists and chat bubbles.
motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling on the landing page.

cinematic_intro.flow: Particle awakening -> neural network -> Indian scripts (Devanagari) -> knowledge -> Living Orb forms -> 'Hello, I'm VAANI'.

living_orb.implementation: Use MeshDistortMaterial or custom shaders for the orb. React to states by changing color, distortion speed, and scale. Include floating particles around it.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary buttons use brand color. Secondary buttons use glassmorphism or soft muted backgrounds.
components.chat: Bubbles should have soft rounded corners, with the sender's tail slightly sharper. Include a confidence score indicator (small pill badge) and citation cards (compact, border-l-2 accent).
components.navigation: Sticky glassmorphic top nav or floating island dock at the bottom/side for the app.
components.icons: lucide-react for UI icons. Must be minimal and clean. Never use AI emojis.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for text. Hover states must have higher contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='voice-input-button').
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the 3D and GSAP animations.

landing_page.description: Man walking through rice field, representing rural India.
Digital network nodes representing AI connectivity.

instructions_to_main_agent: Set up React Three Fiber (R3F) for the cinematic landing page. Create a custom Orb component using MeshDistortMaterial.
For the chat application, prioritize functional SaaS usability. Use Shadcn components heavily customized to match the timeless, Apple/Notion vibe.
Integrate next-themes for Light/Dark mode toggling. The cinematic intro should ideally force dark mode or have a specific theatrical lighting.
Ensure all Shadcn components (Dialog, Dropdown, Select) avoid Vercel-default looks. Use the defined glassmorphism and soft shadows.
Use Framer Motion for page transitions and chat bubble staggering.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, and interactive elements.
The Living Orb should be accessible throughout the app in a minimized state (e.g., bottom right) reflecting the system's voice status.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic. Do not use generic centered layouts or uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Use sonner for toasts.
